rationale.rules-based-checks: Symbolic execution independently checks bounded functional equivalence among generated programs.
rationale.formal-methods: Symbolic execution provides bounded semantic-equivalence reasoning over generated programs.
rationale.risk-routing: Learned uncertainty thresholds decide whether generated responses reach the user.
rationale.built-system: Implemented symbolic clustering with CrossHair and evaluated it end-to-end.
rationale.agentic: Prompts yield complete program artifacts evaluated at an output gate.
rationale.metrics: Defines and validates symbolic cluster count as a quality metric.
rationale.risk-quality: Measures functional correctness and evaluates filtering of incorrect generated code.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled benchmark experiments characterize three third-party code-generation models and detectors.
